_note: The coach model (GDD 4.9.1-4.9.2, built in session C1; read by CoachSystem, scripts/core/coach_system.gd). A coach is a record: {id, name, gender, voice (the personality in data/coaches.json whose words he uses at races), kind (club / parent / remote / academy / personal), real (true = a real coach: facts only from public sources, listed in source; attributes are our estimates from those facts; a neutral professional voice, never invented storylines), source, attributes (the 11 below, whole numbers 1-20), personality (= voice), style (-2 very controlling ... +2 very supportive, words in styles), demands (steady / balanced / ambitious: the season plan he leans to), facts {birth_year, club_id, town, qualification, reputation, event_focus, cost_month, open (takes every club member), spots, min_level}, group (the training group: fictional teammates {id, first_name, last_name, gender, birth_year, event, level, role})}. Effects are measured against `neutral` (10): (attribute - 10) x per_point, so a coach of 10s changes nothing (the M1 / step 7 balance stays exact). Every number here is a first guess for the balance session at the end of M2 part 2 (GDD 4.9.7).

attributes.name: Endurance knowledge
attributes.description: How much your aerobic, threshold and economy work gives you; the quality of his endurance sessions and splits.

attributes.name: Speed & strength knowledge
attributes.description: How much your speed, speed endurance, power and strength work gives you.

attributes.name: Technique
attributes.description: How fast your running technique grows; drills done right.

attributes.name: Periodization
attributes.description: How well his season plan fits you: lighter weeks, the taper hitting your form on the day, the quality of his pick of plan.

attributes.name: Youth development
attributes.description: Under 18: protects a growing body (growth-spurt niggles) and makes the most of your first training years.

attributes.name: Load management
attributes.description: How early and how rightly he spots soreness and load spikes, and changes your days for them.

attributes.name: Race reading
attributes.description: How often his race shouts are right; his clues before a race and his marks on a race video.

attributes.name: Mental coaching
attributes.description: Mental training works better, composure grows faster, confidence comes back faster after a bad race.

attributes.name: Motivating
attributes.description: How much he lifts your motivation; how strongly his praise and criticism land.

attributes.name: Communication
attributes.description: How much and how clearly he explains why; how he gets along with your family and school.

attributes.name: Judging ability
attributes.description: How right his estimates are: time goals, what you can run, the range he gives for your potential.

effects._note: Built in C1: training (the week's trained gains per attribute group, Training._apply_progression) and race_advice (how often his shout on a race card is the sensible answer; at 10 exactly races.json controls.coach.accuracy). Built in C4: endurance and speed & strength knowledge, load management and periodization set how clearly he sees a change (`verdict` below: his noise) and load management how early he looks ahead (`proposals`). Built in M1 (data/mind.json, MindSystem): mental_coaching (composure growth from big meets and the mental plan x (1 + (mc - 10) x composure_per_point); confidence drifts back up faster x (1 + (mc - 10) x confidence_back_per_point)) and motivating (how strongly the coach's words in moments land: x (1 + (m - 10) x lift_per_point); the motivation target + (m - 10) x mind.json drift.motivation.motivating_per_point). Prepared, not used yet (the balance session): youth_development.

pronouns._note: Session C6: the words for a coach by `gender`; `unknown` (a real coach whose sources state none) = they / them / their, never a guess from a name. Texts that use them avoid a verb right after {he} (they 'are', he 'is').

personalities._note: For each voice in coaches.json: lean = points added before the coach's own spread (then centred, so they only say where he is strong and weak), style / demands = weights of the draw.

club._note: The club coach every career starts with (one of the four people of coaches.json, the one picked from the athlete's name as before). User 2026-10-11: club coaches really differ (a volunteer parent vs. an experienced club coach): his overall level (the average of his 11 attributes) is drawn around 10 between average_min and average_max; on top of it his personality's lean and his own spread (spread_sd) make him strong somewhere and weak somewhere. A typical (10) club coach plays exactly like the game before C1. The dice come from his own seed (the athlete's name and birth date), so a career always gets the same club coach. Town size and region (session D1) will move the average later (small clubs lower, the athletics centres higher).
club.town_shift_note: Session C6 (user 2026-10-17, 'moderate shift'): the average is drawn around average_mean + town_shift[size class of the club's town in data/towns.json] (+ centre when the town is one of SUL's athletics centres); a town missing from towns.json counts as 'town' (0). Clamped to average_min..average_max as before.

group._note: The training group that comes with the coach (GDD 4.9.1): fictional teammates of about the athlete's age (youth athletes stay fictional). level = their running level on the attribute scale (the mean of the athlete's physical and technical attributes +- level_sd; role shifts). Used by the people moments (P1) and later the group pull in hard sessions.

temperaments._note: The athlete's temperament, from the creation answer 'Before an important race, you usually...' (background_questions.json, the answer's `temperament`). Older saves have none: fit Fine with everyone.

fit._note: Fit = matrix[temperament][personality] (+1 click, -1 friction, missing 0) + style x style_weight (a supportive style helps everyone; a controlling one hurts all but the no_controlling_penalty temperaments). Score >= click -> 'You click', <= friction -> 'Friction', else 'Fine'. The word shows after reveal_weeks together. User OK 2026-10-11. It sets where trust drifts to (trust.target); motivation follows in session M1.
fit.kind_bonus_note: Session C6: a parent as the coach (GDD 4.9.1: strong fit and motivation, some family friction; the friction is a stress pull in data/mind.json drift.stress.parent_coach).

trust._note: One hidden number 0-100 per coach, shown as a word. New for the first new_weeks together; then Strong from strong, Strained below strained, else Good. Each Sunday it moves rate of the way towards target[fit]; results vs his goals (C5), moments (C2/P1) and vetoes (C4) add to it later (CoachSystem.add_trust). Fit alone never makes it Strained. In C1 nothing reads it.

verdict._note: The coach's verdict on a change (GDD 4.9.2 'Ask the coach', session C4; CoachVerdict, scripts/core/coach_verdict.gd). THE TRUTH: the game plays the change and the plan it replaces on copies (no dice) from today over the rest of this week and window_weeks more: the 800 m ability at the end (the week's training through Training._apply_progression), the expected overuse injuries (the health model's daily hazard at average proneness, as plan_risk), race-day Form at the races in that window. Everything is turned into WEEKS OF TRAINING: train = the ability difference in seconds / a week's gain (the plan's own over the window, at least min_week_s); risk = - extra expected injuries x injury_weeks (racing on an injury adds its escalation chance x escalation_weeks); form = the Form difference in seconds x race_weight (target / other) / a week's gain; a scratched race loses race_value_w (x target_mult for a target). CATEGORIES (thresholds in weeks): Risky = risk or form below -risky; Good idea = total >= good; Pointless = total <= -pointless; else Fine. THE COACH'S VIEW: each part with noise, sd = floor + per_point x (20 - his attribute), times (|part| x rel + abs): train by endurance knowledge (aerobic capacity, lactate threshold, running economy) and speed & strength knowledge (the rest), risk by load management, form by periodization; then his demands weigh the parts (an ambitious coach counts lost training more and risk less: he dislikes Easy days even when right). The same change on the same day always gets the same answer from the same coach (his dice come from the coach, the date and the change). First guesses, calibrated with tools/verdict_check.gd.

proposals._note: The coach changes days himself (GDD 4.9.2 'Proposals and the veto', session C4; CoachProposals, scripts/core/coach_proposals.gd). User 2026-10-11: only when he sees a reason, at most max_per_week a week (scratch advice counted), one a day; with 'Ask me first' every proposal stops Play week; a veto asks for a reason (a reason costs nothing; from the (silent_free + 1)th silent veto within silent_window_days each costs silent_cost trust); 'Never (he notices)': he says what he would have changed, and if it was a real warning (the truth's risk part at least the Risky threshold) and the day was trained as it was, trust - ignored_warning_cost. HOW HE LOOKS: every morning (today) and evening (from tomorrow) he looks look_ahead days ahead (by load management: [from attribute, days]), but only when something catches his eye: soreness (the most strained area / sore_strain), fatigue / fatigue, a race within race_days, a request from the Sunday talk; each signal with his noise (noise_per_point x (20 - load management)), so a poor load manager also sees things that aren't there. Then he tries the candidates (Easy, the hard session swapped for easy_session, a rest day, light_session before a race; heavier ones only when asked) on the days he looks at, skipping played days, race days, days you or an injury changed, days already proposed and the day a 'sore' warning asked you about, and proposes the one HE thinks is best when he thinks it is a Good idea (total >= propose_min_w as he sees it). Scratch advice: a race day within his look-ahead with soreness or an injury, when racing looks Risky to him; it never scratches you by itself (always asks, in 'Never' mode only a message). A request (week talk: lighter_week, more_load) waits request_days for the next morning he looks.

real_note: Real coaches (session D1, 2026-10-17; user: about 12 now, as many as possible once the career reaches adult level). RULES: (1) facts come only from the public pages listed in `sources` (url + the date they were read, 2026-10-17); a fact that is not on those pages is not in the record (null / empty). (2) The athletes named are SENIOR athletes only (Team Finland huiput / haastajat or world level); youth athletes and anyone under 18 are never named, and no coach is described through a minor. (3) The attributes are OUR ESTIMATES (1-20) from the facts, never published ratings: the baseline for a tier is `real_baseline` (national 12, international 15); a documented fact lifts or lowers a single attribute and `basis` says which fact; `evidence` (high / medium / low) tells session C6 how wide the scouting range should be (low = only the role or one athlete is public). No attribute of a real coach is below 10. (4) Neutral professional voice: `personality` (the game voice) is chosen from the published coaching approach and is not a claim about character; `style` 0 and `demands` balanced for everyone (nothing public says otherwise); NEVER an invented personal storyline, quarrel or flaw - those exist only for fictional coaches. (5) `gender` only where a source states it; `unknown` = the game uses they / them (no guessing from a name). (6) `facts_estimated` lists the facts that are OUR guesses for the market (spots, min_level - since session C6 on the 800 m ABILITY scale: the coach asks for the time that ability runs, RacePerformance.time_for, e.g. 13 = 2:00.0 for a boy; C6 moved Suhonen 9 -> 13 and Viskari 8 -> 12 to that scale -, cost_month; a cost_month of 0 with no published fee gets an estimate by reputation from data/market.json fees); `cost_note` quotes what is published. (7) Held back on purpose: coaches of a club where a news item of 2026-09-29 reports an unnamed coach under police investigation (nobody is identified; re-check before release), a coach with a charge filed in news (2025-26), and a centre manager whose post was advertised in July 2026. SAFEGUARD SEARCH 2026-10-17: every name below was searched together with words for allegation / police / charge / controversy (Finnish and English) and nothing was found; a web search is not a guarantee, so repeat it for every real coach before the game is published. Re-read every coach's page before the game is published (people change clubs).
